text: Fat is poor in oxygen compared with its carbon, so it needs a lot of oxygen from outside, and its R Q falls below one. Organic acids are the opposite. Malic acid already carries plenty of oxygen: two molecules need only six oxygen and give eight carbon dioxide. R Q, eight over six, one point three three.
